title: Bengaluru-based edtech startup Emversity raised a $30M Series A led by Premji Invest, sources say at a $120M post-money valuation, up from $60M in April 2025 (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
summary: Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch: Bengaluru-based edtech startup Emversity raised a $30M Series A led by Premji Invest, sources say at a $120M post-money valuation, up from $60M in April 2025 — As AI automates parts of the workforce, Emversity, an Indian workforce-training startup, is building talent pipelines for roles …
